test_policy: This stage authorizes one evaluation of the validation-selected frozen model on both test scenes; no test tuning or candidate comparison. The old corpus protocol describes its earlier collection milestone.
normalization: Train-only mean/std, std floor1e-3; lidar statistics from eligible local patches only
weights: Equal total per train scene, equal per frame within scene, equal per present class within frame; valid rows only

feature_contract.lidar_missing: Zero gated lidar residual, never automatic environment label; keep every sample

validation_selection: Lexicographic: quality-gate pass, minimum scene balanced accuracy, macro scene balanced accuracy, global balanced accuracy, lower FPR, recall, fewer parameters, threshold closest0.5, fixed candidate order
acceptance_scope: Only this tiny same-avatar simulator corpus; quality PASS does not authorize ROS deployment, H1-H5, re-ID/association or World Model training eligibility
training_run_limit: Four fixed candidates, one seed, fixed steps; no additional tuning after test
baseline_reference: All-person prediction is reported on validation only; no learned model uses labels as inputs
